acceptance: Red test first: primary exit 81 cause submit_wedged, remaining candidates benched: the primary is retried once in a fresh session, and a retry that succeeds returns its response.
A non-transient primary failure still walks the chain in bench order.
Docs in STE: the bridgechain package note records the rule.
fix: In bridgechain.Walking.Launch, when the primary exits with a transient cause (submit_wedged, and other causes the bridge classifies transient) and every later candidate is benched, retry the primary once in a fresh session (core.LaunchWithFreshSession) before the walk continues. Keep the bench as advice; do not filter it.

summary: Cycle 2090: claude-tmux failed with the transient cause submit_wedged (exit 81), and the chain walked to agy-tmux, which was benched and exhausted (exit 85), so the cycle failed. The bench orders the chain by design (bench is advice, not a veto, bridgechain.ApplyCLIHealthBench); the gap is that a transient cause on a healthy primary does not retry that primary first.
title: A transient launch cause retries the primary in a fresh session before the chain walks to a benched family
